profile.name: Alaa Salem Mahmoud Abu Rabee
profile.summary: Highly skilled Psychosocial Support professional with 3+ years driving impactful humanitarian programs through GBV-sensitive Case Management and data excellence. Expertly managed over 100 complex GBV cases, delivering 150+ critical support sessions and achieving a 90% positive resolution rate. Achieved 95% data accuracy in M&E systems, developed 50+ individualized care plans, and established 15+ robust referral networks, significantly improving service access. Proven leader coordinating multidisciplinary teams to achieve significant positive outcomes in challenging environments.

volunteering.desc:
Managed and provided support for 100+ complex GBV and psychosocial cases, delivering 150+ critical support sessions and comprehensive psychological first aid to vulnerable beneficiaries, achieving a 90% positive resolution rate.
Developed and executed 50+ individualized care plans, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure tailored and timely interventions, resulting in measurable improvements for clients.
Maintained meticulous documentation for 100+ case interventions, achieving 95% data accuracy, which enhanced M&E and reporting systems and improved data-driven decision making by 20%.
Streamlined 30+ critical case referrals to specialized services by establishing 15+ partner networks, ensuring seamless continuity of care and reducing referral wait times by 15%.
Analyzed data and authored 20+ detailed progress reports, directly informing strategic adjustments and enhancing project impact assessment, contributing to a 10% increase in program effectiveness.

Guided 80+ students with tailored psychological and educational support, boosting academic success and fostering overall well-being by 15% through individualized strategies.
Resolved 25+ behavioral and educational challenges for students, significantly enhancing a positive and supportive learning environment and reducing disciplinary incidents by 10%.
Provided targeted psychological guidance to 90% of caseload, improving student self-confidence and academic engagement and contributing to a 5% increase in attendance.
Collaborated with 15+ teaching staff and parents to establish cohesive support systems, elevating student development and performance and improving overall academic outcomes by 8%.
Directed 10+ successful educational and awareness activities, engaging 200+ students and staff to foster an inclusive school culture and improve communication skills among participants.
